map.合同（服务/价格/条款）生成是做什么的？: What does Service Contract & Pricing Generator do?

map.合同（服务/价格/条款）生成适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Service Contract & Pricing Generator best for?
map.服务/价格/条款: Generate sample contract clauses and pricing text in batches by quantity, supporting first-draft contracts and clause-template tidying.
map.📖 查看「合同（服务/价格/条款）生成使用指南」: 📖 View the "Service Contract & Pricing Generator Guide"
map.合同报价 = 单价 × 数量 ×（1 + 税率）− 折扣额；服务条款按「服务内容: Contract quote = unit price × quantity × (1 + tax rate) − discount; service clauses are assembled as numbered items following "service scope + delivery standard + settlement method + liability for breach + dispute resolution"; payment can be one-off, staged (e.g. 30% / 40% / 30%) or monthly, and late-payment penalties are usually charged at 0.03%-0.05% per day.
map.起草服务合同时批量生成条款与报价样例，作为初稿再逐条修改。: When drafting a service contract, generate clauses and pricing samples in batches as a first draft, then edit them item by item.
map.给客户做报价前先生成几版不同服务项与价格的组合，供内部讨论取舍。: Before quoting a client, generate several combinations of service items and prices for internal discussion.
map.时，用生成的样例补充常见条款措辞。: , use the generated samples to supplement common clause wording.
map.设定生成数量 5，页面从内置服务项（网站开发、品牌策划、法律咨询等）中随机组合，: Set the count to 5 and the page randomly combines built-in service items (website development, brand planning, legal consulting and so on) to produce quote entries with a service description, quantity and amount, ready to use as a quotation skeleton.
map.生成数量被限制在 1–50 条之间，超出范围会按边界取值；需要更多条目可分次生成: The generation count is limited to 1-50; values outside the range are clamped to the boundary. For more entries, generate in several batches and merge them.
map.生成的内容能直接当合同用吗？: Can the generated content be used as a contract directly?
map.不能。生成的是措辞样例，条款效力、金额与权责需由双方确认并经法务审核，正式合同请: No. What is generated is sample wording; clause validity, amounts and responsibilities must be confirmed by both parties and reviewed by legal, and the approved version governs the formal contract.
map.不会。生成与随机组合全部在浏览器本地完成，服务端不接收任何输入。: No. Generation and random combination all happen locally in the browser, and the server receives no input.
map.当前为随机组合生成，暂不支持锁定指定项；可先生成再从结果中挑选合适的条目手工拼接: Generation is currently random and does not yet support locking specific items; generate first, then pick suitable entries from the results and assemble them by hand.
